summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Waste2Worth. All 4 new features verified end-to-end: (1) Live Gemini scan returns source='ai' with correct schema and awards +10 EcoPoints; (2) Saved Addresses seeded (Home/Hostel), CRUD works, empty label/address returns 400; (3) Nearest/Any sort toggle + location banner + category filters all render and toggle active state correctly on Disposal page; (4) Welcome bonus of 20 EcoPoints granted on new signup with addresses=[] and welcome_bonus=20; duplicate email and short (<4) password properly return 400. Regressions all pass: one-tap and email login for user + admin, role-based access (user redirected from /admin to /app), disposal search returns Hazardous guidance for 'old mobile phone'. 13/13 pytest tests pass; all Playwright UI assertions pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py scan() fallback branch (lines 235-236): first `result = {**classify_from_keyword(''), 'confidence': 88}` is immediately overwritten by second assignment to 'Plastic Bottle'. First line is dead code; harmless but should be removed. Also, hard-coding fallback to Plastic Bottle is misleading — a keyword-based inference from the request context or 'Unknown Item' would be safer.
server.py stores plaintext passwords (line 149,163). Acceptable for demo but should be flagged.
server.py add_address() and del_address() do not verify the target user exists — no 404 on unknown user_id; they silently no-op. Consider validating.

Login.jsx: when user is already authenticated and navigates to /admin as a non-admin, the app routes them back to /app (correct), but there is no toast/notification explaining the redirect. Minor UX nit.
Disposal.jsx sortMode + geolocation flow is solid; consider persisting user location to sessionStorage to avoid re-prompting on every visit.
seed_data_creation: No seed data was created. Registration tests use unique random emails per run (qa_unique_<hex>@waste2worth.app, etc.).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs standalone (pytest -v). Uses a pre-generated JPEG at /tmp/bottle_b64.txt (regenerated in the bottle_b64 fixture if missing). Live Gemini scan was verified returning source='ai' with real classification 'Plastic Water Bottle' / Recyclable / confidence 99. Scan test also increments demo user's ecopoints by 10; if you re-run, expect ecopoints to keep growing.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects observed. Only minor code-quality nits listed under critical_code_review_comments.
